operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the prime-to-exponent operation theorem
operations.body: The even-n obstruction generalizes exactly. For any finite abelian deck group G with identity idempotent delta_0, [n]*delta_0=delta_0 iff gcd(n,exp G)=1. Thus the maximal selection-compatible operation indices form the prime-to-exponent multiplicative monoid, generally not an additive submonoid. For five-site G=(C2)^5 this is precisely positive odd n. Exact controls cover C_m (2<=m<=30), five product groups, 90,720 kernel tests, and 43,152 multiplicative-closure checks. This narrows the arithmetic structure: the two-sector common survivor is an odd multiplicative operation system, not the conditional semiring. It is only Adams-like in indexing; no Adams/Frobenius/lambda claim. Packet research/nima/prime-to-exponent-readout-operations.md; graph event 1115.
